answer: Locks are recorded in sonnet, expire in quill, and dune lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 11 aliases as a result needs 168 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2642 identities would post 563 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
